## Highlights

weightclass is now only the launcher it always was underneath: `wclass` starts one
agent CLI process — Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity (`agy`), or Grok — with the
exact command you reviewed. Everything that existed to measure or promise a cost
saving is gone, because the measurements this project ran did not support the
promise. The measured record stays in the README and under `docs/`.

- `wclass-advisory` and the `weightclass.advisory` package are removed, together
  with the packaged Agent Skill bundle, campaigns, verifiers, councils, and the
  speculative cheap-first runner. **0.31.1 is the last release that has them**;
  pin it with `uv tool install weightclass==0.31.1` or
  `pipx install weightclass==0.31.1`. The Homebrew tap follows the latest release
  only.
- `wclass delegate` (role delegation, conformance drivers, the qualification
  registry, `delegate native route|run`) and `wclass v2` (API routing through an
  external runtime) are removed.
- `wclass recommend`, `wclass review-cost-profile`, `wclass render`,
  `classify --ask-vendor`, `classify --show-triage-command`, and
  `run --suggest-escalation` are removed.
- What remains: `discover`, `classify` (local, offline), `route`, `run`, `usage`,
  `example-policy`, `review-preset`, and the policy generators `profile` and
  `select`; policy schemas 1, 2, and 3; the aggregate-only usage store; the
  terminal review default and fingerprint binding from 0.31.1.

## Why

The three-vendor review that shaped 0.31.1 agreed that the one lever with a
large measured effect, model grade, was blocked by a verify gate nobody had
measured. Stage A0 of `docs/cheap-first-decision-plan.md` measured it: the
default verify command caught 6 of 33 blind-injected defects, and a
class-aware invariant script caught 24 of 33 (Wilson 95% [0.56, 0.85]), below
the pre-registered lower bound of 0.80. The plan closed at A0 with a no-go and
the owner chose to narrow the tool rather than keep a framing the data does not
support. `docs/verifier-recall-result.md` has the full reading and
`docs/launcher-scope.md` the removal scope.

## Compatibility and safety

**Breaking change — removed entry point and commands.** `wclass-advisory`,
`wclass delegate`, `wclass v2`, `wclass recommend`, `wclass review-cost-profile`,
and `wclass render` no longer exist. An invocation of a removed subcommand exits
`2` with `{"error": "invalid_input"}`, like any unknown name. The removed flags
on kept commands are rejected the same way. Exit code `8` (`triage_unavailable`)
is no longer produced.

**Breaking change — schema-3 policies that require `native_delegation`.** The
confirmation flag for that requirement was removed with `delegate`; a route that
lists `native_delegation` in `required_confirmations` now exits `3`
`unsupported_route` before the task is read.

Unchanged: every route fingerprint for unchanged inputs (the built-in route
table, the packaged preset files, and the schema-2/3 descriptor goldens are
byte-identical); the one-foreground-child contract; no credential reads, no
network, no persisted task content; the terminal review default and its
non-interactive escape hatches; the usage store format.

The advisory Skill upgrade-ledger step that used to run before the release build
no longer exists, so the "previous bundle" check that failed the `v0.31.0`
candidate cannot recur. The release workflow's validate jobs no longer smoke the
removed commands.

## Documents

Documents that described removed surfaces moved to `docs/archive/` with an index;
nothing was deleted. `HANDOFF.md` was rewritten for the narrowed tool and its
prior contents were appended verbatim to `docs/handoff-archive.md`. The README
lost the sections for the removed surfaces and kept the measured results,
security boundary, and fingerprint binding sections byte for byte.
